records.title: One Token to Seg Them All: Language Instructed Reasoning Segmentation in Videos
records.reason: The work uses language instructions to guide video segmentation reasoning; the objective is segmentation quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: ChatVLA: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Robot Control with Vision-Language-Action Model
records.reason: ChatVLA unifies multimodal understanding and robot control; the primary work is a robotics capability/model paper, not a concrete LLM inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Interpretability at Scale: Identifying Causal Mechanisms in Alpaca
records.reason: Interpretability at Scale identifies causal mechanisms in Alpaca; this is mechanistic interpretability, not inference optimization.

records.title: VISA: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation via Large Language Models
records.reason: VISA uses an LLM for reasoning video-object segmentation and adds segmentation capability; it does not optimize the model's inference resources.

records.title: FreqMamba: Viewing Mamba from a Frequency Perspective for Image Deraining
records.reason: FreqMamba applies Mamba and frequency analysis to image deraining; it is a computer-vision restoration method, not language inference.
